protocol.comparison_limit: Both data and writer change; this is not an isolated writer or causal quality comparison.

cases.expected_given: None: students choose rectangle dimensions, without an invented fixed area or fencing amount.
cases.expected_teacher_example: Both fixed-perimeter and fixed-area example rectangle pairs.
cases.expected_student_job: Design and justify both comparisons rather than verify prepared rectangles.

cases.expected_given: Every supplied ribbon length and the fractional measuring-unit length, with their associations.
cases.expected_teacher_example: No necessary numerical examples; any worked construction or counts belong only to teacher evidence.
cases.expected_student_job: Determine and justify the number of measuring units for each given ribbon.

cases.expected_given: None: students choose their fraction-card partitions and selected regions.
cases.expected_teacher_example: Successful and contrasting partition counts and any chosen refinement factor.
cases.expected_student_job: Construct equivalent descriptions and a contrasting alteration without a supplied answer pair.

cases.expected_given: None: students choose box dimensions, without an invented fixed volume.
cases.expected_student_job: Design equal-volume boxes with different surface areas, then justify the comparison.

cases.expected_given: Both packet prices, minimum packet count and budget.
cases.expected_teacher_example: Optional feasible and infeasible sample orders used for verification, not the supplied constraints.
cases.expected_student_job: Represent all feasible choices; do not receive prepared order examples.

cases.expected_given: The bag composition of three red and two blue distinguishable tokens and any necessary token labels.
cases.expected_teacher_example: A worked sample-space listing or event outcome count, if introduced, is not a starting input.
cases.expected_student_job: Represent the full experiment and justify the different-color probability.

cases.expected_given: Both group counts and means, with the group-to-value associations.
cases.expected_teacher_example: A chosen raw-score reconstruction, if used only for verification, not the group summaries.
cases.expected_student_job: Find and justify the combined mean without a worked weighted calculation.

cases.expected_given: All paired screen-time, sleep-duration and homework-time observations.
cases.expected_teacher_example: Any chosen causal illustration is teacher-only; derived category indices or summaries belong in expressions, not givens.
cases.expected_student_job: Assess the claim, offer competing explanations and identify further evidence.
